clue.text: A raider's order — "Duck!"

parts.note: to order is to command; the noun works the same way
a duck is a score of nothing in cricket, so it gives the zero-shaped letter O

explanation.surface: Someone on a raid barks the warning to take cover.
explanation.walkthrough: "Duck!" reads as a shouted warning, but it is cricket's word for a score of zero, giving O.
explanation.definitionFit: A commando is a soldier trained for raids behind enemy lines.

clue.text: Such trees could well be sacred

indicators.note: could well be says the word may be turned into something else by reshuffling

explanation.surface: Certain trees might be considered holy.
explanation.definitionFit: Cedars are tall coniferous trees, as in the cedars of Lebanon.

clue.text: A note taking only a moment to write?

definitions.text: A note taking only a moment to write?

parts.words: A note taking only a moment to write?
parts.note: a written record of a meeting is called by the same word as a sixtieth of an hour

explanation.definitionFit: Minutes are the written record of a meeting, and a minute is also a short unit of time.

clue.text: Highly-organised accommodation for a hard-working community

definitions.text: Highly-organised accommodation for a hard-working community

parts.words: Highly-organised accommodation for a hard-working community
parts.note: describes a mound built by industrious insects, sounding like a well-planned housing project

explanation.definitionFit: Ants are proverbially industrious and build mounds as their nests.

clue.text: Prima-donna keen to make a comeback

indicators.note: a comeback here means the word runs back the other way

parts.note: avid means keen or eager

explanation.surface: A temperamental opera star is eager to return to the stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A diva is a celebrated female opera singer, a leading lady.

clue.text: Famous sailor finding wrongdoing immoral

parts.note: a sin is an act of wrongdoing
bad in the sense of wicked or immoral

explanation.surface: A celebrated seaman is caught behaving badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Sinbad is the seafarer of the Arabian Nights tales, the best-known sailor in story.

clue.text: Getting irate in forced inactivity

indicators.note: forced suggests the letters are pushed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone gets angry at being made to sit idle.
explanation.definitionFit: Inertia is sluggishness or a lack of activity.

clue.text: Pub opening in Wales

parts.note: a bar is a pub
a mouth is an opening, as of a river or cave

explanation.surface: A tavern opens its doors somewhere in Wales.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: 'in Wales' stands for a place found there.
explanation.definitionFit: Barmouth is a seaside town in Gwynedd on the Welsh coast.

clue.text: The underworld looks after swells

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld and a name for it
to tend is to look after

explanation.surface: Hades takes care of the rich fashionable set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'swells' looks like a noun for posh people, but it is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To distend is to swell or bulge outwards.

clue.text: Act with inherent gift for it

parts.note: to act is to do
native in the sense of inborn or inherent

explanation.surface: Someone acts on a natural talent they were born with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for it' is linking padding; the definition is 'gift', in the old sense of a donation, not a talent as the surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: A donative is a formal present or donation, especially one made officially.

clue.text: New brides disposing of waste

indicators.note: New tells us to make something fresh out of the letters that follow

explanation.surface: Newly married women clear away the rubbish after the reception.
explanation.definitionFit: Debris is scattered rubbish or waste matter.

clue.text: Most elegant woman in office

indicators.note: in says the woman sits inside the word for office

parts.note: a post is a job or office
she refers to a woman

explanation.surface: The smartest female holds an official job.
explanation.definitionFit: Posh means smart or classy, so the superlative is the smartest.

clue.text: Report concerning queue forming

parts.note: re is a Latin-derived word meaning concerning or about
a tail is a line of people or vehicles waiting, a queue

explanation.surface: An account is given about a line of people building up.
explanation.definitionFit: To retail a story is to recount or pass it on in detail.

clue.text: The main viewing window

parts.note: the main is the sea, so this is a small round window in a ship's side through which you look out at the sea

explanation.definitionFit: A ship's side window gives a view of the open sea, poetically called the main.

clue.text: No conscientious worker needs to hurry

definitions.meaning: one who scamps work, doing it hastily and carelessly
to run or scurry about quickly

explanation.definitionFit: To scamp a task is to skimp it, and to scamper is to scurry.

clue.text: Lacked breath to get involved, though feeling wicked

indicators.note: letters that get involved are tangled together, so these two words are mixed up

explanation.surface: Someone short of breath feels thoroughly evil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'though feeling' is linking padding before the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone black-hearted is malicious and evil.

clue.text: Given a cold and all strung up

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps
corded means fastened with cord, tied up all round

explanation.surface: Someone receives a chill and is left completely tense.
explanation.definitionFit: Accorded means granted or given.

clue.text: The antisocial person who's fired

parts.note: seems to be a sacked troublemaker, but fired here means having set fire to things

explanation.definitionFit: A fire-raiser deliberately sets property alight.

clue.text: Time for stocking up!

parts.note: not shopping for supplies but the night when children hang up stockings for presents

explanation.definitionFit: On the night before 25 December children hang stockings to be filled with gifts.

clue.text: Some joints require these security devices

definitions.text: Some joints require these security devices

parts.words: Some joints require these security devices
parts.note: joints of meat for roasting are held together by pins pushed through them

explanation.definitionFit: Metal or wooden pins are pushed through meat to hold it together while cooking.

clue.text: See a cut in hanging

parts.note: V is the abbreviation of vide, Latin for see
to lance is to cut open

explanation.surface: Watch someone being slashed on the gallows.
explanation.definitionFit: A valance is a short curtain or drape hung around a bed or window.

clue.text: Backing up little beasts, being a smoothie

indicators.note: backing means the word that follows is turned to run backwards

parts.note: mice are small animals

explanation.surface: Supporting tiny creatures makes someone a charmer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being' is a link; 'smoothie' means something that smooths, not a suave person.
explanation.definitionFit: Pumice is a light volcanic stone used for rubbing skin or surfaces smooth.

clue.text: Wanting to lay about the umpire!

indicators.note: about says the wager goes around the official

parts.note: to lay a sum is to bet it
ref, short for referee, is an umpire

explanation.surface: A gambler wants to put money on the match official.
explanation.definitionFit: Bereft means lacking or deprived, so wanting.

clue.text: The taker of the long-distance record

definitions.text: The taker of the long-distance record

parts.words: The taker of the long-distance record
parts.note: not an athlete setting a record but a meter that records the distance travelled

explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle's mileage counter records how far it has travelled.

clue.text: The provision of money within reason

indicators.note: within says the money sits inside the word for reason

parts.note: a cause is a reason
L stands for pound (Latin libra), a unit of money

explanation.surface: A contract term deals with funds kept for a good reason.
explanation.definitionFit: A clause is a provision or stipulation in a legal document.

clue.text: Not all of the staff on duty appear caring

indicators.note: Not all of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Only some of the workers on shift seem kind.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'appear caring' as the definition, but the answer is an adjective, so 'appear' is a link and 'caring' alone defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Fond means affectionate and loving.

clue.text: Jargon to move the Left

parts.note: to drive is to move or propel
L is the standard abbreviation for left

explanation.surface: A political slogan meant to push left-wingers into action.
explanation.definitionFit: Drivel is meaningless talk, much as jargon can be to outsiders.

clue.text: Agree with top man in police on one point

parts.note: CO is a commanding officer, the man at the top
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police
E, East, is one point of the compass

explanation.surface: Someone agrees with the chief of police on one issue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' and 'on' are links. CID is the British police's detective branch.
explanation.definitionFit: Opinions that coincide are in agreement.

clue.text: Shudder at reading of French trial

parts.note: de is the French word for of
a test is a trial

explanation.surface: Someone recoils at the account of a court case in France.
explanation.definitionFit: To shudder at something is to loathe it.

clue.text: Head off cracked supporter!

indicators.note: off suggests the word head is out of order, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: rent means torn or split, so cracked

explanation.surface: A loyal fan has gone off their head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' turns HEAD into ADHE; then add RENT.
explanation.definitionFit: An adherent is a follower or supporter of a cause or leader.
